title: Product Strategy
description: Define clear vision, strategic pillars, and measurable outcomes.
Align roadmaps with commercial goals to ensure every initiative drives enterprise value.

title: Rapid Prototyping & MVP Development
description: Design and validate MVPs fast to test hypotheses and de-risk investment.
Run structured experiments with real customers to accelerate 0–1 product journeys.

title: Go-to-Market (GTM) Alignment
description: Bridge product, marketing, and sales to strengthen pipeline and revenue impact.
Refine positioning, messaging, and motion for scalable growth.

title: Execution & Delivery
description: Bring structure and discipline to delivery. Prioritise ruthlessly, embed accountability, and move from roadmap to measurable results.

title: Scaling Product Teams, Processes & Coaching
description: Establish the leadership, rituals, and frameworks that build high-performing product organisations.
Coach teams to execute with clarity, speed, and confidence.

title: Business Transformation & Growth
description: Reshape portfolios, pricing, and positioning to unlock new markets.
Turn underperforming products into engines of sustainable growth.

title: Due Diligence
description: Evaluate product strategy, technology maturity, and organisational strength.
Identify value creation levers and risk factors to support investment, acquisition, or turnaround decisions.

title: Special Projects & Interim Leadership
description: Provide stability and clarity in moments of transition.
Step in to align teams, accelerate delivery, or lead mission-critical transformation.
